q2_gaps: equative / specificational copular clause with a definite-description subject and a proper-name predicate ("The announcer was David David") — the instruction set has no identity relation and no rule for which side becomes the class term, so the parse must silently invert the clause and the uniqueness of "the announcer" is lost
notes: Omitting the `(can announce)` capability atom is correct per the instruction set: here `announcer` is the clause's subject — a referring use — and the capability fires only for a symbol fused from the surface or for a copular predicate. `(Name david_david "David David")` correctly builds one opaque symbol from the whole capitalized run, whatever the name's oddity.
